scripts.dev: concurrently -n back,front,agent -c blue,green,yellow "cd backend && python -m uvicorn app.main:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8001" "cd frontend && npm run dev" "cd client-agent && node src/index.js"
scripts.dev:desktop: concurrently -n front,desktop -c green,cyan "cd frontend && npm run dev -- --host 127.0.0.1 --port 5173 --strictPort" "wait-on tcp:5173 && set FDM_DESKTOP_RENDERER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 && electron ."
scripts.build: npm run build:cases && npm run build:frontend
scripts.test:backend: cd backend && python -m pytest tests/test_chat_feedback_routes.py tests/test_case_library_index_builder.py tests/test_case_library_routes.py tests/test_optimization_prompt_builder.py tests/test_diagnosis_routes.py -v
scripts.test:frontend: cd frontend && npm test -- src/App.test.ts src/api/chatStorage.test.ts src/api/caseLibraryApi.test.ts src/components/layout/Sidebar.test.ts src/pages/CaseLibraryPage.test.ts
